page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.24xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 96 vCPUs and 48 physical cores from an Intel Xeon 8559C processor running at 3.6 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by a 320 MB L3 cache and advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per physical core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, offering 60,000 GB of NVMe SSD storage. This high-density local storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps. The combination of high-speed DDR5 memory and direct-attached NVMe storage makes it highly suitable for data-intensive workloads that require rapid local read and write access without network storage bottlenecks.

In benchmark evaluations, the i7ie.24xlarge demonstrates strong to top-tier performance. Its Intel Xeon processor achieves top-tier results in Geekbench single-core and multi-core tests, as well as Passmark CPU encryption and extended instruction tests. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and static web serving throughput also rank in the top 10% of tested servers. Database operations, including Redis SET operations and Passmark database tests, consistently place in the top 25%. For machine learning, the hardware's AMX instructions support strong prompt processing and text generation speeds for medium-sized LLM models, though text generation for 70B models drops to average tiers due to the lack of dedicated GPU acceleration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the i7ie.24xlarge offers high resource density by bundling massive local NVMe storage with a high-performance compute and memory profile. This consolidation reduces the need for external block storage attachments, optimizing the cost-per-gigabyte ratio for large-scale deployments. The instance is highly recommended for large relational and non-relational databases, high-throughput data warehousing, real-time analytics, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
description: Amazon Web Services i7ie.24xlarge is a storage-optimized instance designed for data-intensive enterprise workloads. Powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor, it features a 96-vCPU Intel Xeon 8559C processor running at 3.6 GHz, 768.0 GB of DDR5 memory, and an extensive 60,000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The system delivers top-tier performance in CPU encryption, multi-core processing, and static web serving, alongside strong database and memory bandwidth capabilities. While it lacks dedicated GPUs, its support for Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions enables efficient CPU-based machine learning inference. This instance provides excellent qualitative cost efficiency for organizations requiring massive local storage combined with high-density compute and memory resources. It is highly suited for large-scale databases, data warehousing, and high-throughput analytical applications.
